name: Opera Estate Primary School

identity.mission: To empower every OPERA Gem to drive meaningful impact and be ready for the future
identity.philosophy: Every child is a Gem, to be polished through the holistic experiences in OEPS.
identity.valuesNote: The school states its values as the acronym R2IGHT, and aims to create opportunities for pupils to learn and meaningfully apply them, so as to form a strong sense of identity and make good choices across contexts.
identity.foundedNote: Formed in 1985 from the amalgamation of Opera Boys’ School and Opera Girls’ School.

sampleClassesNote: Class codes are Opera Estate’s own, read from the staff timetable. Sample classes are starting points a teacher can rename or delete.

alp.name: Opera Goes Green (OPG)
alp.verbatim: The Applied Learning Programme (ALP) “Opera Goes Green” seeks to instill in our students the importance of responsible actions towards environmental care and sustainability and to take actions through critical thinking and innovating practical solutions to advocate a more sustainable way of life within and beyond the school.

prongs.blurb: Create awareness of environmental sustainability issues
Motivate students in taking environmentally-conscious actions
Empower students to advocate for environmental causes

alp.prongsNote: The three prongs of OPG are described by the school as the 3 As.

digitalMaker.name: Digital Maker Programme
digitalMaker.verbatim: In line with Smart Nation and a need to inculcate entrepreneurial dare and lifelong learning, the P4 and P5 levels go through a Digital Maker Programme which integrates STEM with Sustainability education. Students learn coding and computational thinking using a micro:bit. They then go through a Design Thinking process to create prototypes using recycled materials to tackle real-life environmental problems.

llp.name: Ignite D' Arts @ OEPS
llp.verbatim: The Learning for Life Programme (LLP) “Ignite D' Arts@OEPS” provide opportunities for students to have a deeper appreciation for the Arts and develop the confidence in articulating one's expression for the Arts.

pal.name: Programme for Active Learning (PAL)
pal.verbatim: PAL runs as a timetabled subject at Primary 1 and Primary 2.
pal.source: Opera Estate's own staff timetable (2026 Term 1)
